items.title: Monitor Amazon Aurora DSQL costs with the Aurora DSQL console and CloudWatch alarms
items.summary: As your Amazon Aurora DSQL workload scales, DPU consumption and storage costs can grow without a fixed instance ceiling. This post shows how to monitor Aurora DSQL usage and cost with the built-in Usage and cost panel, set up Amazon CloudWatch alarms for hourly DPU spend, and deploy the alarms as code with AWS CloudFormation.
items.creator: Tejas Dubey

items.title: Storage layout and best practices for Amazon RDS Custom for SQL Server
items.summary: Amazon RDS Custom for SQL Server gives you OS-level access, which also exposes internal storage volumes where the W: drive looks like a raw, uninitialized disk. This post explains the C:, D:, and W: drive architecture, how the drives map to Amazon EBS, and the safe disk operations and verification checks that keep you from accidentally destroying your data.
items.creator: Olushola Oladipupo

items.title: Modernizing document storage for search, scale, and agility
items.summary: Storing extracted document data in a relational JSON or BLOB column works until you need search and scale. Learn how to recognize when document data has outgrown relational storage, and how to choose between Amazon DocumentDB and Amazon DynamoDB using a progressive, low-risk migration pattern.
items.creator: Ravi Teja Bellamkonda
